notable_absence.finding: This 8.0 page gates XATTRs mappings behind Couchbase Server 7.6.2 ('You can only use XATTRs mappings on Couchbase Server version 7.6.2 or later'), but the measured Capella twin (cloud/search/about-mappings.json, similarity 0.96) records no availableSince relation for search:xattrs-mapping at all - either Capella's own page states the gate differently (e.g. as a Capella-native availability marker rather than a Server-version marker) or the earlier extraction pass over the Capella page did not capture it. Flagging for the coordinator since it is the one substantive divergence found between two otherwise near-duplicate pages.

cross_component_finding: None found on this page beyond what the Capella twin already established.
cross_product_finding: This is the measured 0.96-similarity twin of cloud/search/about-mappings.json, and the content is confirmed near-duplicate as predicted: identical mapping taxonomy (Collection/Object/Child Field/XATTRs, static-vs-dynamic choice), identical British Shorthair cat JSON example, identical Collection Type Mapping Names / Object Names guidance about avoiding periods in field/object names. The one real difference found is the availableSince version:server-7-6-2 gate on XATTRs mappings, present verbatim on this server/ page but absent from the Capella extraction - see notable_absence. Confirms the cloud extraction's own forecast that 'this concept id and its sub-concepts be treated as strong cross-product candidates once/if a matching server/ page is processed' (cloud/search/about-mappings.json).
